frozen_C11_facts.residual_common: z is adjacent to y and y'

proof: Consider the ordered seven vertices y'-z-y-s-p-m-n.
Consecutive edges y'z, zy, ys, sp, pm, mn are frozen.
Nonconsecutive y'y, y'p, y'n, yp, yn, pn are absent because {y,y',p,n} is stable.
z is nonadjacent to s,p,m,n because z is in descendant Y0' and hence anticomplete to the enlarged seed; p,m,n are stored seed vertices and s is an old seed vertex.
ym is absent by the source symmetry orientation f'(m) in L(y).
sm is absent because m belongs to original Y0 and is anticomplete to original seed S.
sn is absent because n has original type T' and s is in T minus T'.
Thus the only nonconsecutive adjacency not already forbidden is y'm.
If y'm were absent, y'-z-y-s-p-m-n would be an induced P7, contradicting P7-freeness.
Therefore y'm is forced.

R2_FIRST_LIST_DIFFERENCE.claim: f'(m) is in L(y) minus L(y').
proof: The source orientation gives f'(m) in L(y).
By R1, y' is adjacent to m and m is in the enlarged seed with color f'(m).
Therefore f'(m) is excluded from L(y').

R3_SECOND_LIST_DIFFERENCE.claim: f(s) is in L(y') minus L(y).
proof: Since s is in T, y is adjacent to s, so f(s) is excluded from L(y).
Since s is not in T', y' is nonadjacent to s.
All vertices of T' have the unique seed color f(T'), and f(T') differs from f(T)=f(s).
Hence y' has no original-seed neighbor colored f(s), so f(s) belongs to L_old(y').
Property (5) provenance gives L_old(y')=L_new(y'), so f(s) belongs to L(y').
Both lists are distinct 3-element subsets of the four-color set.
Therefore each directed set difference has exactly one element.
R2 supplies the element of L(y)\L(y'); R3 supplies the element of L(y')\L(y).
Cycle edges y'z, zy, ys, sp, pm and my' hold, with my' from R1.
Every non-cycle pair is frozen nonadjacent: y'y, y's, y'p, zs, zp, zm, yp, ym, sm.
Therefore the six vertices induce exactly C6.

R6_PENDANT_N.claim: In the induced subgraph on {y',z,y,s,p,m,n}, n has exactly one neighbor, m.
proof: mn is an edge.
n is nonadjacent to y', y and p by the frozen stable set.
n is nonadjacent to z because z is anticomplete to stored support.
n is nonadjacent to s because n has type T' and s is not in T'.

canonical_kernel.interpretation: P7-freeness converts the old terminal P6 escape into a rigid closing-chord configuration coupling graph adjacency to the exact two singleton list differences.

source_consistency.source_terminal_facts: Directly matches the acceptability paragraph: z anticomplete to V(Q), {y,y',p,n} stable, orientation f'(m) in L(y), and induced P6 z-y-s-p-m-n.
source_consistency.new_reasoning: Only P7-freeness and frozen type/list semantics are added; no new state or repair hypothesis is introduced.

scientific_interpretation.strongest_supported_statement: Every authoritative-core C11 acceptability survivor satisfying the frozen source orientation has a forced y'-m closing edge. Consequently the seven-vertex survivor kernel is an induced C6 y'-z-y-s-p-m-y' with pendant n at m, and the two unequal 3-lists differ exactly by the crossed colors f'(m) and f(s).
not_claimed: that the kernel is the only obstruction outside C11
that C1S, CS1 or CSS are reachable or unreachable
that a bounded descriptor based on this kernel is sufficient
